comment: This is VCV's own CV-MIDI with an MTS-ESP client added. With a master connected the pitch voltage is turned into a frequency and the master is asked which note that frequency belongs to (CV_MIDI_MTS_ESP.cpp:93-96), so the note number follows the master's mapping rather than twelve-tone tuning; with no master it falls back to twelve semitones to the volt around note 60.
